task: Fidelity envelopes re-grounded on the original's observed figures; bots gain a FinalPass after the year's last auction so the seeded run complies fully; legacy bot snapshots restore FinalPass at 0.92; envelope six skip reason re-measured; docs updated to the new golden figures

claims.claim: Envelope one (year 1 zero penalties, >=74% company-years comply, shortfall <=5% of obligations) and envelope two (year-1 auction average 100-130; year 3 above year 1 and below 300) pass on the seeded run; on the previous engine they fail (year-1 penalties 3, compliance 66.8%, year-1 price 137.90)
claims.base_fail_pattern: Expected Measured\.PenaltyCountByYear\[0\] to be 0|Expected compliant to be greater|Expected Measured\.AuctionAveragePriceByYear\[0\] to be between|error CS|Failed:\s+[1-9]

claims.claim: FidelityTests.cs holds the re-grounded bounds: year-1 penalties be 0, compliance >= 0.74, shortfall <= 5% of obligations, year-1 auction average in 100-130, year 3 > year 1 and < 300, with no Skip on envelopes one and two
claims.run: f=tests/CarbonSim.Engine.Tests/FidelityTests.cs; grep -q 'PenaltyCountByYear\[0\].Should().Be(0)' $f && grep -q 'BeGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0.74m)' $f && grep -q 'obligations \* 0.05m' $f && grep -q 'AuctionAveragePriceByYear\[0\].Should().BeInRange(100m, 130m)' $f && grep -q 'yearThree.Should().BeGreaterThan(yearOne)' $f && grep -q 'yearThree.Should().BeLessThan(300m)' $f && ! grep -B1 -E 'void Envelope_(one|two)_' $f | grep -q 'Skip' && echo BOUNDS-OK || { echo BOUNDS-MISSING; exit 1; }

claims.claim: BotTrigger has FinalPass, drawn in 0.88-0.96, and on it the bot settles with lastChance: true (no offsets wanted, whole shortfall covered with allowances)
claims.run: grep -q 'FinalPass' src/CarbonSim.Engine/Bots/BotAction.cs && grep -q 'BotTrigger.FinalPass\] = random.NextDecimal(0.88m, 0.96m)' src/CarbonSim.Engine/Bots/ComplianceBot.cs && grep -A2 'Due(year, BotTrigger.FinalPass, elapsed)' src/CarbonSim.Engine/Bots/ComplianceBot.cs | grep -q 'lastChance: true' && grep -q 'offsetsWanted = lastChance ? 0m' src/CarbonSim.Engine/Bots/ComplianceBot.cs && echo FINALPASS-OK || { echo FINALPASS-MISSING; exit 1; }

claims.claim: The seeded run's golden records 726 of 726 compliant company-years and 0 penalties for the Normal run (first section)
claims.run: g=tests/CarbonSim.Engine.Tests/Golden/fidelity-golden.md; awk '/Compliant company-years/{print; exit}' $g | grep -q 'Compliant company-years: 726 of 726' && awk '/^- Penalties:/{print; exit}' $g | grep -q 'Penalties: 0 worth 0; market shortfall 0 t' && echo GOLDEN-OK || { echo GOLDEN-NOT-FULL; exit 1; }

claims.claim: The golden test The_seeded_run_still_matches_the_golden passes against the new golden
A bot saved before FinalPass existed restores with FinalPass at 0.92
Envelope six is skipped with a reason quoting -68.64 to 108.80, matching the golden's first 'Bot cost of compliance per tonne' line
claims.run: g=$(awk '/Bot cost of compliance per tonne/{sub(/.*per tonne: /,""); print; exit}' tests/CarbonSim.Engine.Tests/Golden/fidelity-golden.md); echo "golden: $g"; s=$(grep -A1 'Skip = ' tests/CarbonSim.Engine.Tests/FidelityTests.cs | grep -B1 'void Envelope_six_' | grep 'Skip = '); [ "$g" = '-68.64 to 108.80' ] && printf '%s' "$s" | grep -qF -- "$g" && echo SKIP-MATCH || { echo SKIP-NOMATCH; exit 1; }

claims.claim: docs/handover.md, docs/tester-guide.md and docs/trainer-runbook.md no longer quote 137.90, 268.66, '485 of 726' or 122.04, and quote the golden's 126.63 / full 726 compliance
claims.run: if grep -nE '137\.90|268\.66|485 of 726|122\.04' docs/handover.md docs/tester-guide.md docs/trainer-runbook.md; then echo DOCS-STALE; exit 1; fi; grep -q 'Auction average price by year: 126.63' tests/CarbonSim.Engine.Tests/Golden/fidelity-golden.md && grep -q '126.63' docs/handover.md && grep -q '726 of 726' docs/handover.md && grep -q '126.63' docs/trainer-runbook.md && grep -q 'All 726 company-years comply' docs/tester-guide.md && echo DOCS-OK || { echo DOCS-MISSING-NEW; exit 1; }

claims.claim: dotnet build CarbonSim.sln has 0 warnings and 0 errors
dotnet test CarbonSim.sln is fully green across the 3 test projects
